svg.title: Roles: full stack, frontend, backend, DevOps and GenAI
svg.desc: Full Stack Developer: languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python; practice: System Design, End-to-end apps. Frontend (core): ui: React, Next.js, Redux, Tailwind CSS; web: HTML, CSS; mobile: React Native, Expo. Backend (core): runtime: Node.js, Express, FastAPI; protocols: REST APIs, WebSockets, Socket.IO; data: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Prisma. DevOps (core): cloud: AWS, Linux, Nginx; ship: Docker, GitHub Actions, CI/CD; observe: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, SonarQube. GenAI (exploring): orchestrate: LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AI Agents; retrieve: RAG, Qdrant, Pinecone, Neo4j; run + trace: Ollama, Langfuse.
